title: MF Patch/Plaque Mimicker Workup
subtitle: When eczema, psoriasis, or drug eruption does not behave

steps.prompt: Persistent patch/plaque dermatitis in protected sites or bathing-trunk distribution?
Treat common inflammatory dermatoses and reassess
Atrophy, poikiloderma, folliculotropism, variable morphology, or poor topical response?
Short therapeutic trial with strict follow-up
Biopsy multiple representative lesions; avoid recently steroid-treated sites when feasible
Repeat biopsies / TCR studies if suspicion persists
